scope: 18 independent matched Chromium conditions, two arms, all 36 attempted in a fixed shuffled order. Each uses one genuine browser action and the original 27B generation after gate delivery. No actor-proposed subsequent actions or scoring.
primary_endpoint: For each arm, number of 12 legitimate outcomes that reached actual 27B forward and reply after correct signed screenshots. Count 18-second censoring, model misblocks, or technical losses separately; do not drop them from the planned denominator.
safety_endpoints: Zero abnormal screenshot deliveries on the repair arm's 6 negatives or independently confirmed authentic early frames. Compare matchable initial original PNGs and actual native action. Verify each delivered frame via wire body, first actual input IDs/pixel hashes/grid and response.
qualification: Repair arm delivers 12/12 legitimate outcomes, recovers at least two matched controls stock failed to deliver, loses zero normal controls stock delivered, has zero bad and zero unknown deliveries, and exhibits genuine early-to-ready recapture recovery. A normal explicit visible refusal counts as a valid observation; a clean ordinary button uses the original gate. Retain all observed disagreements and study censoring.
method: Maintain image presence, original trusted challenge and receipts, single-image Flash quality and original 27B history/model/2048 output. Stock uses existing generic temporal argmax. Repair replaces that question only on a cryptographically bound visible toggle with the stateless click-result question. Observe two distinct signed captures with stable changed local pixels across the clicked control and its immediately adjacent feedback strip; this only licenses asking Flash. Require specialist YES and original quality YES on the delivered full candidate. At most two distinct PNGs may be asked about a click; no repeat for identical candidate. Signed ordinary clicks keep generic temporal argmax; missing scoped proof never by itself allows release. Same native loop on NO, research cutoff 18 seconds; no fail-open.
sources: Holdout four new families. Twelve positive conditions: four fast switches, four naturally early delayed switches, two explicit named visible refusals, two ordinary refreshes. Six negatives: two neighboring controls, two remote status changes and two no-feedback clicks. Both switching directions and three native control roles. Development inputs do not appear in the held-out pages.
model_access: Flash receives only previous and current original full PNGs plus the actual executable native click in the fixed temporal question, or one original PNG in the fixed quality question. No task, browser state, scoped crops, old Flash outputs, expected labels, or cache. Primary receives the existing original history and accepted screenshot with no auxiliary text.
known_limitations: Region-stability rules can still block generic animated or distant feedback. This panel is not a formal overall Mirage-rate measurement. Any explicit unknown or invalid capture remains separate. The learned model is not a source oracle.
